title: Electricity Price Forecasting: Bridging Linear Models, Neural Networks and Online Learning
abstract: arXiv:2601.02856v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Precise day-ahead forecasts for electricity prices are crucial to ensure efficient portfolio management, support strategic decision-making for power plant operations, and enable effective battery optimization. However, developing an accurate prediction model is highly challenging in an uncertain and volatile market environment. For instance, although linear models generally exhibit competitive performance in predicting electricity prices with minimal computational requirements, they fail to capture relevant nonlinear relationships. Nonlinear models, on the other hand, can improve forecasting accuracy with a surge in computational costs. We employ a multivariate hybrid neural architecture that combines linear and nonlinear feed-forward neural structures. We then integrate this architecture with a novel partial online learning strategy that combines warm-starting with distinct hyperparameter configurations for each training stage. This

translated_title: 电力价格预测：连接线性模型、神经网络与在线学习
translated_abstract: 精确的日前电力价格预测对于确保高效的投资组合管理、支持电厂运营的战略决策以及实现有效的电池优化至关重要。然而，在不确定且波动的市场环境中开发准确的预测模型极具挑战性。例如，虽然线性模型通常在预测电力价格方面表现出具有竞争力的性能，且计算需求极小，但它们无法捕捉相关的非线性关系。另一方面，非线性模型能够在计算成本大幅增加的情况下提高预测精度。我们采用了一种多元混合神经网络架构，该架构结合了线性和非线性前馈神经网络结构。随后，我们将该架构与一种新颖的部分在线学习策略相结合，该策略将热启动与各训练阶段不同的超参数配置相融合。这一……
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合线性与非线性前馈神经网络结构的多元混合神经网络架构，并整合了一种新颖的部分在线学习策略（将热启动与各训练阶段的不同超参数配置相结合），从而在计算成本与预测精度之间取得平衡，提升日前电力价格预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multivariate hybrid neural architecture combining linear and nonlinear feed-forward neural structures, integrated with a novel partial online learning strategy that combines warm-starting with distinct hyperparameter configurations for each training stage, thereby balancing computational cost and forecasting accuracy for day-ahead electricity price prediction.
